title: Rename the legacy acceptance mode to self-asserted and give show --json one shape
outcome: The default acceptance mode is called self-asserted everywhere, and completed items always report their acceptance provenance in one JSON shape.
acceptance: No code identifier, receipt text or doc calls the default acceptance mode legacy
Stored policy records without an acceptance_evaluation field still read as the self-asserted default
TermAl needs no change, confirmed by a search of its Engram adapter for the acceptance field

show --json on a completed item always includes acceptance, with provenance self_asserted or evaluated, or unavailable when its acceptance history is missing or unreadable. The unavailable acceptance block carries error_class when provenance validation supplies a failure class; otherwise it may omit error_class, preserving shipped behavior.
